name: Viper
description: A small serpent that envenomates its prey with hinged fangs.

abilities.name: Minion (4)
abilities.description: The Viper is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Viper, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

abilities.name: Venomous
abilities.description: When the Viper makes a successful standard attack, the target becomes temporarily Envenomated. While Envenomated, the target must mark a Stress whenever they make an action roll.

abilities.name: Group Attack
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Vipers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 1 physical damage each. Combine this damage.
